images.caption:
Size chart comparison between some of the largest described phorusrhacid species:
  Kelenken guillermoi → Height = ~3 metres (9.8 ft).[1]
  Devincenzia pozzi → With a 65 centimetres (26 in) long skull,[1] size extrapolated after Kelenken.
  Phorusrhacos longissimus → Height = ~Equivalent to Titanis.[2]
  Titanis walleri → Height = ~1.4–1.9 metres (4.6–6.2 ft).[3]
Human for scale is 1.8 meters tall.

References
1 2 "Neogene Birds of South America" in   (2013)  South American and Antarctic Continental Cenozoic Birds, Springer Briefs in Earth System Sciences, Springer, pp. 59–86  DOI:  10.1007/978-94-007-5467-6_7. ISBN:  978-94-007-5466-9. 
↑ (2003). "Systematic revision of the Phorusrhacidae (Aves: Ralliformes)". Papéis Avulsos de Zoologia 43 (4): 55–91. DOI:10.1590/S0031-10492003000400001.
↑ (2005). "Titanis walleri: bones of contention". Bulletin of the Florida Museum of Natural History 45 (4): 201–229. DOI:10.58782/flmnh.xumx1681.
